interface.title: OncoAgent-GBM (v2.0 / guide v2.10.1)
interface.field: Neuro-oncology drug discovery: cheminformatics, molecular docking, pharmacology, biostatistics, transcriptomics
interface.stage_of_work: Early hit triage and in-silico validation, then analysis of the researcher's own assay, survival and expression data
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit toolkit for glioblastoma drug discovery, with a stated target focus on the CDC25A/B/C phosphatases. It screens SMILES for drug-likeness and blood-brain-barrier penetration, validates and runs AutoDock Vina docking, fits IC50 curves, and runs Kaplan-Meier, log-rank and docking-enrichment statistics. It also does differential expression and co-expression on expression tables. Every output is labelled by its source.

data.note: I used built-in examples only: the GBM drug library dropdown (lomustine), the default dose-response pairs, Freireich 1963 leukaemia survival data, simulated docking scores (30 actives / 300 decoys) and a simulated expression table (1,200 genes, 8 tumour vs 8 normal). I typed in two small 4-atom ligand poses for the manual RMSD check and five drug SMILES for Compound tools. There were no test files to upload. I downloaded ic50_4pl_fit.csv and de_results.csv. Real docking is impossible on this server: the app reports AutoDock Vina and OpenBabel as MISSING, and fetching from RCSB fails because the server has no network access.

tree.general: Triage candidate compounds and check them computationally, then analyse your own experimental and omics data
tree.specific: Screen GBM drug SMILES for Lipinski/BBB and profile/cluster a compound list, check pose RMSD, fit IC50, run survival and enrichment statistics, and run differential expression and co-expression (e.g. around CDC25B)

Read the descriptor tiles and PASS/FAIL compliance

Place the compound on a permeability map to judge brain penetration

features.name: Pose RMSD pass/fail checker
features.general: Paste two sets of coordinates for the same object, compute their RMSD, and get a pass/fail verdict against a threshold

features.specific: 4PL IC50 Fit: dose,response text box and dose-unit label, then Fit 4PL; IC50/Hill/R²/Top/Bottom/N tiles, log-scale plot with IC50 line, Download your data + IC50 (CSV); rejects fewer than 4 points
